blocks.en: Let $\mathcal{M}^{m\times n}$ be the set of $m\times n$ matrices. A function $G:\mathcal{M}^{m\times n}\to\mathbb{R}$ is said to be \textbf{polyconvex} if $\bm{A}\mapsto G(\bm{A})$ can be represented as a convex function of the subdeterminants of $\bm{A}$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\mathcal{M}^{m\times n}$ 为 $m\times n$ 矩阵的集合. 若 $\bm{A}\mapsto G(\bm{A})$ 可以表示为 $\bm{A}$ 的子行列式的凸函数, 则称函数 $G:\mathcal{M}^{m\times n}\to\mathbb{R}$ 为\textbf{多凸的}.
blocks.label: def:polyconvex-function

blocks.en: In elasticity, where $\bm{F}(\bm{x})$ is the deformation gradient at $\bm{x}\in\Omega$, the components of $\bm{F}(\bm{x})$ reflect local changes under the deformation in the length of curves going through $\bm{x}$, the components of $\operatorname{cof}\bm{F}(\bm{x})$ reflect changes in the areas of variously oriented surfaces and $\det\bm{F}(\bm{x})$ reflects the local change in volume.
blocks.zh: 在弹性中, $\bm{F}(\bm{x})$ 为 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ 处的形变梯度, $\bm{F}(\bm{x})$ 的分量反映形变下经过 $\bm{x}$ 的曲线长度的局部变化, $\operatorname{cof}\bm{F}(\bm{x})$ 的分量反映各种定向曲面面积的变化, 而 $\det\bm{F}(\bm{x})$ 反映体积的局部变化.

blocks.en: The physical objections raised in the literature for convex stored energy functions do not apply to polyconvex functions. Polyconvexity is widely accepted as an assumption which is both extremely general and physically reasonable.
